messages:
Maya (PM): Heads-up — prepping the roadmap deep-dive on inference economics tomorrow. Need succinct RICE inputs for the four perf levers: batching, prefix cache, quantization, and dedicated/reserved capacity. Please add impact/effort + launch criteria by EOD.

Alex (Eng): Quick roughs from infra POV. Batching: high impact for high-throughput flows, effort medium (2 sprints infra+runtime). Cache/prefix: medium-high impact, high effort (integration + correctness). Quant: medium impact, low-medium effort (model eval + packaging). Dedicated: high impact on p95 predictability, high effort (sales/ops/legal).

Sam (ML): Quant caveat: per-model eval required. For 7B-style models int8 gives ~10-20% perf gain, but 3-5% metric drift on worst-case safety prompts. Need gating eval set; launch only if regression < X% on our alerting set.

Priya (Data): Usage context: 3 customers contribute ~60% of long-session tokens; they require p95 <250ms. Baseline numbers: current avg token cost ~$0.0025, overall p95 520ms on hosted for those flows. Batching/caching could drop cost for those segments by 25-40%.

Rishi (SRE): Operational notes: p50 is fine; p95 needs capacity guarantees or tighter batching windows. Autoscaling for Dedicated increases oncall surface for ~1 month during rollout. Failure modes include cache staleness -> incorrect outputs; need rollback playbook.

Ava (Design): Quick UX input: users notice jitter >150ms. If batching slightly increases median but stabilizes p95 we can accept it, but need to experiment with holdback and clear telemetry.

Maya (PM): For RICE we need numbers: Reach = #reqs/day affected, Impact = relative user/business lift, Confidence = data confidence. Can everyone drop a line with Reach/Impact/Confidence/Effort so I can normalize?

Alex (Eng): Putting concrete roughs to start:
- Batching: Reach 600000 req/day, Impact 0.8, Confidence 0.7, Effort 4 (dev-sprint units).
- Prefix cache: Reach 400000 req/day, Impact 0.6, Confidence 0.6, Effort 6.
- Quantization: Reach 1200000 tokens/day, Impact 0.3, Confidence 0.6, Effort 3.
- Dedicated capacity: Reach 200000 req/day, Impact 0.9 (p95 stability), Confidence 0.5, Effort 8.

Priya (Data): I'll attach the per-customer token attribution and p95 baselines to the doc (uploading shortly).

Sam (ML): Suggested launch criteria (short):
- Quant: automated evals green for 7 days, regen rate delta <1% on core prompts, safety checks pass.
- Batching: staging p95 <350ms under 95th percentile load, no request starvation.
- Cache: correctness tests + TTL/eviction metrics stable for 48h in canary.
- Dedicated: capacity reservation verified under 2x expected QPS, failover tested.

Rishi (SRE): Canary/rollback playbook snippets: route 10% traffic for 24h, monitor p95, 500s, cost/token. Rollback if p95 regresses >10% or error spike >2x. Example canary config: ```route: weight:10% duration:24h metrics: [p95,5xx,token-cost]```

Maya (PM): Perfect. Last ask: drop a one-line RICE score or normalized marker here so I can synthesize before the meeting. I'll author the final slide with these numbers. :thumbsup:

Alex (Eng): Batching -> R:600k I:8 C:70 E:4 -> raw RICE-ish rank queued in doc.

Priya (Data): Prefix cache -> R:400k I:6 C:60 E:6.

Sam (ML): Quant -> R:1.2M I:3 C:60 E:3.

Rishi (SRE): Dedicated -> R:200k I:9 C:50 E:8.

deploy-bot: Note: roadmap-deep-dive doc updated -> https://redwood.internal/notes/infra/prioritization (auto).

Maya (PM): Thanks everyone — I'll synthesize and paste the normalized RICE table + crisp launch criteria into the doc by 9pm PST. Meeting 10am PST tomorrow.

(emoji reactions: :thumbsup: on several messages)
